Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL4135 (Geranylgeranyl transferase type-1 subunit beta). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno (inner join required). Filter where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation is '=', pchembl_value is not null, and target chembl_id is CHEMBL4135. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
